text: {"fixed_clause": "In the event of any security incident or unauthorized access involving personal data, the Vendor shall notify the Customer without undue delay and no later than seventy-two (72) hours upon becoming aware of the breach, to enable the Customer to comply with its obligations to notify the competent authority and data subjects."}

data.fixed_clause: In the event of any security incident or unauthorized access involving personal data, the Vendor shall notify the Customer without undue delay and no later than seventy-two (72) hours upon becoming aware of the breach, to enable the Customer to comply with its obligations to notify the competent authority and data subjects.
